videos.title: How To Deploy Machine Learning Models Using FastAPI-Deployment Of ML Models As API’s
videos.description: This video teaches how to deploy machine learning models as APIs using FastAPI, a Python web framework. It covers building and exposing ML models effectively through API endpoints.

videos.title: Introduction To FastAPI- How To Create API's Using FastAPI- Data Science
videos.description: This video introduces FastAPI, a Python web framework for building APIs. It covers FastAPI's features, including its high performance, Python type hint integration, automatic documentation generation, and autocomplete support in editors, for creating production-ready APIs.

videos.title: Deploy ML models with FastAPI, Docker, and Heroku | Tutorial
videos.description: This video demonstrates deploying machine learning models using FastAPI. Topics covered include developing the model, building a FastAPI application, containerizing with Docker, and deploying the application to Heroku for cloud hosting.

videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates building an initial API using FastAPI in Python. It covers the fundamentals of creating a high-performance web API with Python 3.6+ and standard type hints, focusing on the core concepts of the FastAPI framework.

videos.title: FastAPI Introduction - Build Your First Web App - Python Tutorial
videos.description: This video introduces FastAPI, a modern Python web framework. It explains key features and demonstrates building a web application using FastAPI, covering fundamental steps for API development.

videos.title: #2 FastAPI Setup in VS Code
videos.description: This video details the initial setup of FastAPI within a VS Code development environment. It covers the necessary steps to configure FastAPI for use.

videos.title: #4 FastAPI - Pydantic and Fetching all products
videos.description: This video demonstrates integrating Pydantic with FastAPI for data validation and serialization. It specifically covers fetching and handling multiple product entries within a FastAPI application.

videos.title: How to Deploy FastAPI on AWS EC2: Quick and Easy Steps!
videos.description: This video demonstrates deploying a Python FastAPI application to an AWS EC2 instance. It covers launching and connecting to EC2, installing pip and NGINX, configuring NGINX for API traffic routing, running the FastAPI server, and testing the API.
